skill.summary: Generate customer-facing answers for common market research questions. Use when working on FAQ content for analysts, founders, strategy teams.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — Generate customer-facing answers for market research FAQ pages.

- Enables creation of FAQ content tailored for analysts, founders, and strategy teams.
- Supports clarification of audience, goals, and deliverables for accurate responses.
- Integrates with chat and web search APIs for enriched answers.
- Emphasizes output review before external publishing or automation.
- Optimized for SEO with targeted keywords related to FAQ generation and market research.
